import pytest
from store.cart import Cart, Item
from store.coupons import CouponError


def test_issue_save10_two_items():
    """A percent coupon takes that percent off the whole subtotal."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="mug", name="Mug", price_cents=1200))
    cart.add(Item(sku="shirt", name="T-Shirt", price_cents=2500))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 370  # 3700 * 10 // 100 = 370


def test_issue_save10_quantity():
    """A percent coupon takes that percent off the whole subtotal, including quantities."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="mug", name="Mug", price_cents=1200, qty=3))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 360  # 3600 * 10 // 100 = 360


def test_issue_halfoff_two_lines():
    """A percent coupon takes that percent off the whole subtotal."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="mug", name="Mug", price_cents=1200))
    cart.add(Item(sku="shirt", name="T-Shirt", price_cents=2500))
    cart.apply_coupon("HALFOFF")
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 1850  # 3700 * 50 // 100 = 1850


def test_issue_percent_rounds_down():
    """A percent coupon takes that percent off the whole subtotal, rounded down to the cent."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=199))
    cart.add(Item(sku="b", name="B", price_cents=199))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 39  # 398 * 10 // 100 = 39 (39.8 floored)


def test_issue_percent_shipping_uses_full_discount():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=3000))
    cart.add(Item(sku="b", name="B", price_cents=2500))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 599  # 5500 - 550 = 4950 < 5000 so 599


def test_issue_percent_total_uses_full_discount():
    """total = discounted subtotal + shipping + tax, and is never negative."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="mug", name="Mug", price_cents=1200))
    cart.add(Item(sku="shirt", name="T-Shirt", price_cents=2500))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    assert cart.total_cents() == 4195  # 3330 + 599 + 266 = 4195


def test_contract_subtotal_sums_lines():
    """Subtotal is the sum of price_cents * qty over every line in the cart."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="mug", name="Mug", price_cents=1200, qty=2))
    cart.add(Item(sku="shirt", name="T-Shirt", price_cents=2500, qty=1))
    assert cart.subtotal_cents() == 4900  # 1200 * 2 + 2500 = 4900


def test_contract_add_same_sku_increases_qty():
    """Adding a SKU that is already in the cart increases that line's qty."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="mug", name="Mug", price_cents=1200))
    cart.add(Item(sku="mug", name="Mug", price_cents=1200))
    assert cart.items[0].qty == 2  # 1 + 1 = 2


def test_contract_second_coupon_raises():
    """At most one coupon may be applied to a cart."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="mug", name="Mug", price_cents=1200))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    with pytest.raises(CouponError):
        cart.apply_coupon("HALFOFF")


def test_contract_fixed_coupon_minimum():
    """A fixed coupon takes a flat amount off, but only when the subtotal is at least the coupon's minimum."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="cheap", name="Cheap", price_cents=1500))
    cart.apply_coupon("FIVEOFF")
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 0  # 1500 < 2000 so 0


def test_contract_discount_never_exceeds_subtotal():
    """The discount can never exceed the subtotal."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="cheap", name="Cheap", price_cents=300))
    cart.apply_coupon("TENOFF")
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 300  # min(1000, 300) = 300


def test_contract_empty_cart_no_shipping():
    """An empty cart has no shipping charge."""
    cart = Cart()
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 0  # empty cart so 0


def test_contract_free_shipping_at_threshold():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="shirt", name="T-Shirt", price_cents=2500, qty=2))
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 0  # 5000 >= 5000 so 0


def test_contract_tax_eight_percent():
    """Tax is 8% of the discounted subtotal, rounded half up to the cent."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="shirt", name="T-Shirt", price_cents=2500))
    assert cart.tax_cents() == 200  # (2500 * 8 + 50) // 100 = 200
